input: Reach out to my university career center for advice

gold.taskTitle: Reach Out to University Career Center for Advice
gold.taskDescription: Contact the university career center to seek professional guidance relevant to the user's current career situation or goals.

questions.title: What specific career topic do you need advice on?
questions.description: Understand the exact focus area such as resume review, job search, internships, interview prep, or career switching.

questions.title: Are you a current student or a recent graduate?
questions.description: Determine the user's academic status to confirm eligibility and the type of services available to them.

questions.title: Have you contacted your career center before?
questions.description: Find out if the user is familiar with the process or if this is their first time reaching out.

questions.title: Do you prefer an in-person, phone, or virtual appointment?
questions.description: Identify the user's preferred format for the meeting or consultation.

questions.title: Is there a deadline driving this outreach right now?
questions.description: Determine if there is a time-sensitive event such as a job application deadline, recruitment season, or upcoming interview.

questions.title: Do you already know your career center's booking process?
questions.description: Find out whether the user needs help locating the website, phone number, or scheduling portal for the career center.

questions.title: What outcome do you want from this appointment?
questions.description: Clarify what a successful interaction looks like, such as a revised resume, a referral, an action plan, or general direction.
